hq_location.notes: The company lists a New York City address.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site has multiple product and integration articles, including setup, click tracking, Shopify, and product overviews.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 seed round falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook's company profile states that Malachyte was founded in 2024.

last_funding.notes: Malachyte announced a $10 million seed round on August 6, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog history does not show a product or major-feature launch in the six-month window; its dated August 2026 announcement is the seed funding news, not a product launch.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer offer demo/pilot pathways but no pricing page; the apparent /pricing URL returns a 404.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn gives the broader company size of 11–50; Malachyte's team page lists 13 people including the founders, supporting the narrower 11–20 band.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page says there are no open positions.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed product documentation, technology information, and the privacy policy; Malachyte describes proprietary Vector AI/visual-transformer technology but does not publicly identify an underlying model or provider.

named_customers.notes: All three are listed as customer case studies.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page says there are no open positions and offers only an open application.

compliance_certs.notes: The technology page explicitly claims SOC II Type 1 certification and GDPR compliance; no other requested certifications were named.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The documentation names Shopify as a commerce integration, and the privacy policy names Google Analytics as an analytics service; neither identifies a CRM or sales/marketing system as a stack signal.

product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes behavior profiles and personalization across the shopping journey; the product page details its commerce use cases.
product_one_liner.value: Malachyte provides real-time, behavior-based personalization for ecommerce search, recommendations, and product discovery, for online retailers and commerce brands.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The team page lists the founders and current team but provides no dates for executive or VP appointments, and I found no dated join/departure announcement that could establish a change in the period.
